newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus telecoms, Greece OTE in internet deal.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus telecoms, Greece OTE in internet deal.

text.p: The Cyprus Telecommunications Authority (CyTA) on Thursday said it has concluded a deal with Greece's OTE for faster internet access between the two countries for its subscribers.

The deal allows the immediate link-up of the internet networks of the two companies with a 128kbps line which will speed up connections between the two networks and will save overall capacity on the internet, a statement from CyTA said.
The agreement would, it said, further CyTA's goal of becoming a regional hub for internet accessing services for its clients in Cyprus and neighbouring countries.

"Representatives from the two sides agreed to widen their cooperation in other areas of the Internet and in new markets. A new meeting has been scheduled in Athens in the coming days," the CyTA statement said.
CyTA, a semi-governmental organisation, offers Internet services in Cyprus and the Middle East. It offers the fastest internet link available in Cyprus today with a 2Mbps line to the United States.
